comparison.cryptography_change: The former 41.0.0 compatibility minimum is outside the supported range at this commit; 50.0.0 has no listed advisories in these queries.

minimum_advisory_conditions.condition: Attacker-controlled URL processed by legacy PackageIndex.download can cause arbitrary file writes.
minimum_advisory_conditions.applicability: Not called by CASF runtime or the locked candidate build/install procedure.

minimum_advisory_conditions.condition: Non-ASCII MANIFEST.in exclusions may fail across NFC/NFD path normalization when creating an sdist on macOS filesystems.
minimum_advisory_conditions.applicability: CASF manifest patterns at this commit are ASCII; locked build backend 84.2.1 is newer than the fix. Artifact member inspection remains separate evidence.

minimum_advisory_conditions.condition: On Windows, a crafted namespace_packages.txt passed to legacy Wheel.install_as_egg can create a fixed-content file outside the destination.
minimum_advisory_conditions.applicability: Not used by CASF runtime or the Ubuntu/macOS locked installation procedure.

minimum_advisory_conditions.condition: Unpacking a crafted wheel through wheel.cli.unpack can change permissions outside the destination through archive path traversal.
minimum_advisory_conditions.applicability: Minimum compatibility tooling only; not part of CASF runtime or the locked candidate dependency set. The vulnerable unpack API is not used by the checked CASF source/CI workflow.

assessment.disposition: No newly identified runtime or locked release-tool package finding, and no new dependency-query reason to replace the intended locked candidate artifacts. Existing minimum-only build-tool advisories remain documented limitations; minimum compatibility success is not security clearance or a recommendation to use those old tools. This scoped review does not itself approve publication.
assessment.license_declarations: PyPI license fields/classifiers retained. mypy-extensions 1.1.0 still lacks those JSON fields; its retained MIT license-file evidence is documented in docs/release/reviews/dependency-review.md. That prior evidence was not independently refreshed here. No new legal or bundled-native license clearance is claimed.
limits: Package queries are dated snapshots, not absence-of-vulnerability proofs.
Native OpenSSL, Python TLS, SQLite, operating-system patches and all allowed dependency versions are outside this query scope.
Minimum extra versions came from the prior actual validation inventory; these queries do not independently establish which dependencies a future installation will select.
Existing installations can retain older satisfying build tools; prefer the reviewed locked environment.
